entry_state: Participation rights allocate earnings before division, and assumed issuance can change both numerator and denominator. The capped fixed-rights family has a restricted additive-gross-effects ordering derivation. Joint bonus and tax consequences invalidate isolated increments, and final selection remains unresolved; contingent options additionally require their similar outstanding instrument prerequisite. Participating-dividend tax benefits have been allocated across three years, with a negative residual adjustment preventing duplication. The final payout-invariance interpretation continues next.
exit_state: EPS allocations can include hypothetical tax consequences without creating journals. Consolidation uses evidenced control, identified entity books and a separate adjustment book. Acquisition, intragroup profit and tax, monetary remeasurement and presentation translation have distinct calculations. The foreign-subsidiary case follows goodwill, parent and NCI reserves, cash and disposal, including full removal on loss of control. The next section has begun binding those calculations to exact books, currencies and control intervals.
findings: The participating-dividend allocation closes with an explicit distinction between hypothetical numerator amounts and reported profit or journals.
The foreign-subsidiary case separates cash translation effects from total OCI and attributes proportionate-NCI goodwill translation wholly to the parent.
The disposal examples retain all removed subsidiary cash, retained investment fair value and the full parent reserve recycling; several wrong intermediate methods can share final totals.
Group book identity is introduced as necessary to prevent a consolidation removal becoming a fictional parent payment. No new confirmed defect.
